newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Asia Investment depressed by low debut price.
newsitem.headline: Japan Asia Investment depressed by low debut price.

text.p: Shares in newly listed Japan Asia Investment Co Ltd continued to slip on the over-the-counter market on Friday, depressed by the initial price of the shares which was lower than expected, brokers said.
The shares, which were listed on Wednesday, were at 1,270 yen at 0112 GMT, after closing at 1,360 yen on Thursday. The trade volume was 758,000 shares.
The public offer price of the shares was 1,400 yen and the initial price was 1,470, contrary to hopes that the price would be as high as 2,000 yen, brokers said.
Japan Asia Investment provides loans for ventures in Japan and other parts of Asia.
